title: Traffic by destination
description: Average events per second received by each WAF endpoint and IPS destination IP. Times are UTC.

export.label: Export CSV
export.note: Large exports are cut at the server's limit and marked in the file.
export.disabledLoading: not available while the data is loading.
export.disabledError: not available: the data could not be loaded.
export.disabledNotCollected: not available: this source is not collected.
export.disabledInsufficient: not available: no complete bucket in this window.
export.disabledEmpty: not available: nothing to export in this window.

span.basis: Average events/s over {width}-minute buckets, divided by measured time only.

share.known: {unattributed} of {total} events ({share}) are not attributed to a listed {noun}. A total built from these rows is a lower bound.
share.unknown: The part of the source's events that no listed {noun} carries is not known for this window, so a total built from these rows is a lower bound.

banner.partialMissingText: Only {measured} of {expected} buckets in this window have a usable measurement. Rates divide by the measured time only; a missing bucket is not counted as zero.
banner.partialIncompleteText: Some measured buckets were incomplete, so figures for the entities marked partial may be low. A missing value is not counted as zero.
banner.truncatedText: Collection stopped admitting entities in at least one bucket of this window, so some endpoints or addresses may be missing and the figures shown are lower bounds.

reasons.unknown: The backend gave a reason that this page does not describe.

insufficient.title: No complete bucket in this window.
insufficient.text: Nothing can be ranked until the source has a complete stored bucket. This is not a statement that no traffic arrived.

notCollected.titleWaf: This WAF source is not collected.
notCollected.titleIps: This IPS source is not collected.
notCollected.textWaf: It has no enabled, validated behavior profile, so no traffic was stored for it. Set it up in WAF sources administration.
notCollected.textIps: It has no enabled, validated behavior profile, so no traffic was stored for it. Set it up in IPS sources administration.

noSource.titleWaf: No WAF source has a behavior profile.
noSource.titleIps: No IPS source has a behavior profile.
noSource.textWaf: Nothing is collected until a log source is mapped and validated. An empty list here does not mean there is no traffic.
noSource.textIps: Nothing is collected until a log source is mapped and validated. An empty list here does not mean there is no traffic.

empty.titleWaf: No endpoint has data in this window.
empty.titleIps: No destination IP has data in this window.
empty.textWaf: The source stored no request count for any tracked endpoint in these buckets. That is an absence of data, not zero requests. Try a longer window.
empty.textIps: The source stored no event count for any admitted destination IP in these buckets. That is an absence of data, not zero events. Try a longer window.

cut: Showing the first {shown} of {total} (sorted). Export CSV has the full list.

pastEnd.title: This page is past the end of the list.
pastEnd.text: There are {total} {noun} in this window and the offset is {offset}.

errors.title: Traffic could not be shown.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to view traffic. It needs the anomaly:read permission.
errors.expired: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
errors.notFound: This log source is not known. Choose another source above.
errors.failed: Traffic could not be loaded, so nothing is shown. The backend may be unreachable; check that it is running, then reload the page. Nothing was changed.
errors.sourcesFailed: The list of sources could not be loaded, so no source can be chosen. Reload the page; if it persists, check that the backend is running. Nothing was changed.

summary.waf: {total} endpoints in this window, sorted by {sort}, {order}.
summary.ips: {total} destination IPs in this window, sorted by {sort}, {order}.
summary.wafOne: {total} endpoint in this window, sorted by {sort}, {order}.
summary.ipsOne: {total} destination IP in this window, sorted by {sort}, {order}.

table.captionWaf: WAF endpoints ranked by average events per second
table.captionIps: IPS destination IPs ranked by average events per second
table.trendLabel: events/s from {start} to {end}, low {low}, high {high}, {gaps, plural, =0 {no gaps} one {1 gap} other {# gaps}}
table.coverageHint: This row has data in fewer buckets than were measured; its rate divides by the measured time of the whole window.
table.retiredHint: No longer tracked; listed because it has data in this window.
table.partial: {count, plural, one {1 partial bucket} other {# partial buckets}}

links.wafRow: Open the endpoints of this source
